The '''Atzerri system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]] and the primary star of the [[Atzerri (star)|same name]].
